name: Chord Vamp
description: Chord progressions — perform, shift+tap capture, or auto vamp

sections.heading: Modes
items: Perform — scrub a pitch map of the genre’s unique degrees across ~3 octaves; hold the button to sound the chord
Auto — genre rhythm phrase loops on the clock; harmony Repeats or Meanders; short press play/pauses
Shift + short press toggles Perform ↔ Auto; Perform + Shift + short also commits Capture when the ring has chords

sections.heading: Capture
items: Commits the last N bars (Capture length: 16 / 8 / 4 / 2 / 1) into a timed clip; starts snap to the 16th grid
Empty ring → Auto runs the genre phrase (no Capture slot)
Auto long press clears the capture clip and reseeds the genre phrase
Shift + long press (Auto) — panic (All Notes Off)

sections.heading: Groove
items: Feel (Button + Fader) — laid back ↔ advanced hit lengths; Capture playback durations scale too; rests stay genre-driven
Swing (scene storage, genre-seeded) — delays odd 16ths on Auto hits and Capture playback; resets when you pick/reseed a genre

sections.heading: Faders
items: Perform Main — scrub genre degrees × octaves (low → high)
Auto Main — tension (Meander drift; ignored in Repeat)
Shift + Fader — genre (Dub → … → Dubstep; rose = Capture clip slot when a clip exists)
Button + Fader — Feel (hit length / Capture dur scale)

sections.heading: Jack param
items: CV Out, CV In Macro, or CV In Panic — Macro modulates scrub (Perform) or tension (Auto); Panic fires All Notes Off from CV

channels.jackDescription: CV Out: chord root pitch while held/sounding (0V idle). CV In Macro or CV In Panic.
channels.faderDescription: Perform: pitch map (genre degrees × 3 octaves). Auto: Meander tension.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Cycle genre preset (Capture clip slot when a timed clip exists).
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Laid back ↔ advanced hit length (Capture durs scale too). Rests unchanged.
channels.fnDescription: Perform: hold for chord. Auto: short = play/pause. Long (Auto): clear clip / reseed.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Short: toggle Perform↔Auto; Perform+Shift+short = capture. Long (Auto): panic.
